name: the Arrival Figure
descriptionSeed: The Figurists built a yard round their gate because arrivals kept stepping through into places that had not agreed to have them. Now you arrive in a figure drawn to receive you, and a courteous Figurist explains which of the paths is real today. Armies find this very difficult.
appearance: A plaza that is not quite square, around a gate arch that is not quite where the plaza's centre should be. Paths lead off toward the city at angles that suggest several different cities. One of them is right.
encounterFlavor: A courier walking the wrong path for the third time, cheerfully; a guide drawing the way in on your palm in chalk that does not rub off; a cart that arrived at an angle and has to be persuaded out of it.
